chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Al-Husayn ibn Zurara, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Build your house up to seven cubits, so whatever is above that, the Satans would dwell in it. The Satans are neither in the sky nor in the ground, but rather they dwell in the atmosphere'.
ai.seo_question: Where do the Satans dwell according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes a seven-cubit height for residential structures, linking architectural limits to a specific cosmological domain where Shayatin reside in the atmospheric air rather than the heavens or earth. This narration reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating physical habitation with spiritual hygiene, suggesting that excessive height may facilitate the presence of unseen entities. The emphasis on 'seven cubits' aligns with traditional architectural norms of the era, serving as a practical guideline for maintaining a sacred domestic environment.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Al Husayn Bin Zurara, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Build your house up to seven cubits, so whatever is above that, the Satans<sup>la</sup> would dwell in it. The Satans<sup>la</sup> are neither in the sky nor in the ground, but rather they dwell in the atmosphere’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Bashir from Al-Husayn Zurarah from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Build your house seven yards high; anything higher than this becomes residence of Satans. Satans do not live in the sky or on earth. They live in the air.’”
